name: Basics
overview: The foundational truths of Scripture begin with God as Creator, who established all things from the beginning (Genesis 1:1). God’s sovereign plans for His people are rooted in His loving intentions to give them hope and a future (Jeremiah 29:11). Central to the Christian life is seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that He will provide for our needs (Matthew 6:33). The gospel reveals God's immense love through the gift of His Son, Jesus Christ, who is the exclusive way to eternal life and reconciliation with the Father (John 3:16; John 14:6). Believers are assured of Christ’s peace, a peace that surpasses worldly understanding and calms fear and trouble (John 14:27).
